carries: Apple's own swipeActions works outside a List since iOS 27, through swipeActionsContainer() on the scroll view: one row open at a time, scrolling closes it, a tap elsewhere closes it. The app uses it when it is there

below iOS 27 the hand-drawn swipe stays, with the fault that broke it fixed: disabling the row to stop its Button from firing also disabled the gesture sitting on it, so the Button now reads an environment flag instead
the gesture no longer claims priority over the scroll view, which is what made a scroll take two or three tries
recipeByID and resultFor are indexed, cooked is held in memory, and the swipe field is drawn only while a row travels
